text:
If you're planning an outdoor Friday, this is a pretty good one, though the damp, mostly cloudy start will take a while to lift. Expect more sun later, a high right around 78, and just a slight shower chance between 2 and 3. The American and Canadian models are mostly dry, but the European model is dramatically wetter, so I'd keep a rain jacket handy rather than betting the whole afternoon on sunshine. A stray shower is also possible this evening.

Saturday looks cooler and more unsettled, with a high near 73, a north wind around 12 mph, and showers possible in the morning, then again with a chance of a thunderstorm during the afternoon. On the lake, today brings light chop and waves a foot or less, but tonight and Saturday build to 1- to 2-foot waves with north winds of 10 to 15 knots. Take advantage of the calmer water today, and keep Saturday plans flexible after lunch.

week.blurb: A mostly sunny, seasonable Friday near 78, but keep a jacket handy for a stray shower late afternoon or evening.
Showers are possible much of Saturday, with a cooler high near 73 and a brief thunderstorm chance midafternoon.
A mostly sunny Sunday near 73 follows an early shower chance, with a clear, cool night settling in.
Labor Day looks sunny and comfortable near 77, with rain chances holding off until after dark.
Tuesday turns mostly sunny and cooler near 71, though a few early showers could affect morning plans.
Wednesday trends unsettled near 73, with showers developing and rain becoming likely overnight as south winds strengthen.
Thursday looks wet and breezy near 77, with likely showers and thunderstorms through the afternoon.
